zeroed_freed_cells.symptom: the sparse-attention prefill kernel (qsa3) sums P*V on the matrix cores, and the sums move in the last bit with the V of keys weighted by exactly zero - the free cells after a conversation's last one, up to its block boundary. Those held whatever an earlier conversation or a rejected draft left there, so a result depended on the cells' history (0.1.16 kept q8_0 V unrotated because a rotated V spread that bit into a conversation read back from disk)
zeroed_freed_cells.fix: a cell freed by seq_rm, seq_keep, a move or clear has its K and V rows zeroed by async copies from a zero tensor kept in each cache buffer, on the graphs' stream (STRIX_KV_ZERO_FREED=0 leaves them)
zeroed_freed_cells.proof: q8_0 with V rotated (the case that parted before): a 34K conversation B processed over A's freed cells hashes the same as B alone after every prompt batch, and answers with the same tokens and top-3 logprobs; without zeroing the two part
zeroed_freed_cells.cost: about 0.5% of decode with MTP (greedy A/B, one conversation); with MTP off a fresh conversation frees nothing
zeroed_freed_cells.v_rotation: kept off for qwen4exp as in 0.1.16: with zeroed cells a rotated V would be safe, but the disk tier stores q8_0 conversations unrotated in rows of the same size, and the quality is the same within error (mean KLD against f16 0.013941 +/- 0.000669 K rotated, 0.013736 +/- 0.000699 both, kv-q8-20260924.json)

mtp_carried_row.symptom: tmp/kvr/rewind_probe.py: the same ~85K-token prompt twice, greedy, 400 tokens, MTP; the second pass rewinds to the checkpoint 4 tokens before the prompt's end. 0.1.16 and the build with zeroed cells alone: the passes part at token 133 (" " against "\n"), draft acceptance 245/441 against 252/409 - the second step already drafted differently
mtp_carried_row.cause: the draft context pairs each token with the target's hidden row of the position before; the last row of a batch is carried to the next (pending_h). After the rewind the carried row was the one of the previous request's last position, so the draft cache's row at the rewind point differed
mtp_carried_row.fix: the row keeps its position (zeros when it does not belong, as at a fresh start); get_state/set_state put it into checkpoints (data_spec, stored by the disk tier), the RAM tier's entries, the disk tier's restore point and child slots; a restored slot file clears it
mtp_carried_row.after: both passes: the same 400 tokens, acceptance 245/441 and 245/441
mtp_carried_row.note: the probe's top-3 comparison was vacuous for speculative tokens (the server sets no probabilities on that path); the ids are what is compared
